title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Charred, marinated chicken simmered in a rich, spiced tomato-cream curry.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.instruction: Combine chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, and garam masala. Cover and refrigerate.
steps.tips: The longer it marinates, the more tender the chicken gets — up to overnight is great.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.instruction: Melt butter in a hot skillet and sear the marinated chicken until charred at the edges. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Build the curry base
steps.instruction: In the same skillet, sauté the onion until golden, then add garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.instruction: Stir in crushed tomatoes, cream, chili powder, and salt. Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer.
steps.tips: Simmer uncovered so the sauce thickens rather than staying thin.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.instruction: Top with fresh cilantro and serve hot with rice or naan.
